notes.title: Bad Bots Rise v1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Game changes[/h1]

The 1.2 update is here! The update includes significant gameplay changes along with some new levels and the game's first boss, Baxor.

[h1] Bad Bots Rise v1.2.0 - Screenshots and GIFs

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vd0Vry5.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/GBRZvf9.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Swq6ap8.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6GbCPec.png[/img]


[b]Gameplay changes:

[/b]

This gameplay change includes the removal of stage select.


This update aims to make the gameplay simpler by removing the stage select. Unnecessary button clicks will be removed. Thus, the player can enjoy a smoother transition between levels. This will make the player traverse the game in a one-way fashion and remove replayability of the levels. Therefore, an arcade mode will be added in the future updates to compensate with the removal of the replayability of levels.

The character select during player death was also removed and instead, the player will now have Health Points instead of lives. Changing characters is now different. Characters in cages will be found in levels. The player can swap characters by freeing captured characters on cages. This will also replenish their health points too to help them fight their way out of the level. 

[b]New Levels:[/b]
5 new challenging levels are added to the game. These new levels, 11 to 15, are much harder and larger than the previous 10 levels. 

[b]New Boss:[/b]
The first boss, Baxor, is added to the game. Baxor is a flying cube, with a deadly spinning gun that spins and targets the next gun to the player. Boxar creates spike drones, that targets the player with deadly spinning spikes.
